# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Chapter

---

** ¶1. ** Know also this: Before the external forms that once held spiritual good were expelled and fell from the interior states of wisdom , three states of deep containment in the lower mind were first prepared and established by Divine Providence, into which those degraded forms would be confined and held fast , so that they could not spread beyond their bounds .

**¶2.** Before the vast ruling fals ity was cast out from the ordered arrangement of spiritual life , the Divine Providence of the In most prepared a place for it within the great general body of natural knowledge that lies within the boundaries of doctrine — the same field through which doc trinal systems pass , and where the fullness of truth shall ultimately be restored .

**¶3.** Before a certain deep evil was made manifest to all the levels of the mind, and fell into the natural understanding , and its own intention gave it shape there , the Divine Providence of the In most prepared a place for it in the lower regions — below the four elevated states of celest ial good , yet above the lesser elevations of the interior mind — a broad receptive state holl owed out within the material level of consciousness , in the midst of all the mind 's planes . When the In de structible Divine Truth was sent against it, that Truth pursued it sw iftly to its place, struck it, and cast it down between elevated states of good, into the con fin ement prepared for it — where it is held imm ovable until the final consummation .

**¶4.** Before the imp ur ities and refuse of spiritual ignor ance were pur ged from the created mind , deep states of spiritual vastation were prepared , into which all such refuse would be buried and sealed until the dissolution of the present spiritual age .

**¶5.** Before the insurg ent falsities arose — those whose whole body of thought rebelled against the divine governance of both the interior and exterior will — those fals ities that turned out ward, and also the dom inating ev ils in whose very core lay the comp ulsion to tyr annize amid obsc ur ities, veils of ignorance, shifting persu asions, spiritual influences , and storms of tem ptation: for all of these, seven states of final containment were established at the ou termost boundary of the mind's knowledge , places from which they are cast into the utter most depths of fals ity and spiritual darkness .

**¶6.** Likewise , before the spiritual con ceptions that failed to come to birth — incomplete goods and truths that could not reach full form — fell into the natural mind , a separated state was set apart for them: they are gathered into that state and remain there.

**¶7. ** Again, before the guardian intelligences — those whose function was to watch over divine order — reb elled and descended from the interior states of wisdom, a state of spiritual imprisonment was fashioned and established for them in the depths of the natural mind, below the elevated states of good .

**¶8.** Before the offspring of self -love were brought forth — those derivative states in which there is no knowledge of righteousness and no particle of the Divine — a complete arrangement of thirty -six doc trinal enc losures was assigned and built , in which these offspring of self-love would dwell: they who would continue to generate from one another, they who would persist through a full and complete age of spiritual duration .

---

* A note on method : * The entire chapter concerns a single spiritual principle — that Divine Providence prep ares states of containment and restraint * before* ev ils and falsities manifest . Every prison , d itch, geh enna, hos tel, and city corresponds to an interior provision whereby what is spiritu ally di sordered is confined to its proper boundary , so that it cannot destroy the regener ating mind . The " fash ioning before the fall " is not temporal sequence but spiritual priority : the Lord 's f oresight prec edes and en cl oses every eru ption of evil .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Before these vessels were discharged and swept down from heaven, first three ditches were fashioned and constructed for them, in which they would be bound and fettered.

Also, before the [great beast] was displayed to the worlds [and came down to] the earth [and it f]ell to the sea and its thought shaped it, the Father of Life constructed a place for it in [the depths of the earth,] below the four mountains, above the mountains of the heavens above [them, in] that [place where] a great plain it digs in Matter in the midst of the worlds. When the Adamant of Light was sent to it, he hastened after it to that place, smote it and threw it between mountains in the place made ready for it [; and a seal] is set fast upon it till the end of the universe.
Before the waste and dirt of the Darkness were swept out from creation, gehennas were constructed in which the waste might be covered till the dissolution of the universe.
Also, before the abortions [fell and came down] to the earth, there was set apart [a place for them]: they are gathered in and dwell therein.
Again, before the watchers rebelled and came down from heaven, a prison was fashioned and constructed for them in the depths of the earth, below the mountains.

Before the children of the giants were born, they who had [no] knowledge of righteousness in them nor divinity, thirty-six cities were assigned and constructed for them wherein the children of [the giants would] live; they who would come to beget from each other, they who shall spend ten hundred years alive.

Before the sea giant was discharged from the sphere, the Father of Life constructed a place for [him i]n this great sea that is within the walls, whereon the ships sail, and where the fullness shall [ ... ... ]

Before the rebels rose up, they whose corps rebelled in the ruling-power above and below, they [ ... ] outside, and also the tyrants in whose heart it lay [to ty]rannise amongst the murk and the clouds and winds and spirits and storms; for them were constructed in the great outer sea seven hostels, places whence they are thrown into the depths and the Darkness [ ... ]
